exposure: Injection of 500 µl of mesenchymal stromal placental cells (MSPCs) extracellular microvesicles (EMVs)
finding: Intra-surgery injection of mesenchymal stromal placental cells (MSPCs) extracellular microvesicles (EMVs) was well-tolerated and associated with a lower rate of infectious postpartum complications in women undergoing cesarean delivery.
